dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Prominent and sharp white edges are clearly visible along the margins of the folded primary and secondary flight feathers, creating high contrast with the dark feather bodies.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A discernible boundary is visible where the uniform grey-brown texture of the crown transitions into the scalloped/scaled texture of the upper mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: The entire dorsal surface displays a highly regular scalloped pattern resulting from narrow, pale fringes on the mantle, scapular, and covert feathers.
